test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The new / secretary / does not likes / me.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb form** "likes" after "does not." **
 
• In English, when using** "does not" (or "doesn't")**, the base form of the verb should be used, which is "like" in this case.
 
• The correct phrase should be** "does not like,"** ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The new secretary **does not like me__."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The new" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "secretary" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "me." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
